text:
Which statement about the nuclei of all atoms is correct?
A
They are very small compared with the size of the atoms.
B
They always contain the same number of protons as neutrons.
C
They contain electrons, neutrons and protons.
D
They have a total charge of zero.

options.label: A
options.text: They are very small compared with the size of the atoms.

options.label: B
options.text: They always contain the same number of protons as neutrons.

options.label: C
options.text: They contain electrons, neutrons and protons.

options.label: D
options.text: They have a total charge of zero.
